newsitem.title: CANADA: Scotiabank confirms in Venezuela talks.
newsitem.headline: Scotiabank confirms in Venezuela talks.

text.p: Bank of Nova Scotia confirmed on Thursday that it was in talks to acquire a stake in Venezuela's Banco del Caribe, but that no deal had been reached.
"We have had discussions with them, but nothing has been finalized at this point and no deal has been reached," Scotiabank spokeswoman Catherine Hanrahan said in a telephone interview.
Edgar Dao, head of Banco del Caribe, said on Wednesday the Canadian bank planned to take a 25 percent stake in the family-owned bank with assets of 35 billion bolivars (US$71 million).
"We hope to reach an agreement before the end of 1997. Many details still have to be worked out...but we've already gone a long way," Dao said.
Toronto-based Scotiabank is Canada's fourth largest bank and has extensive operations abroad. The bank has a representative office in Caracas.
